children: The third edition of Hyundai’s customer engagement initiative will run from October to December, featuring family entertainment, live experiences, interactive activities and community-led experiences

Hyundai Motor India Limited (HMIL) has announced the third edition of Hyundai Explorers Carnival, a customer engagement initiative designed to bring Hyundai owners and their families together through entertainment, interactive activities and shared experiences.

The 2026 edition will be held across five cities between October and December, beginning with Pune on October 3, followed by Lucknow, Ludhiana, Bhubaneswar and Hyderabad. The initiative is exclusively curated for Hyundai customers and their families, with the company expecting thousands of participants across the five-city programme.

The Explorers Carnival is positioned as an extension of the Hyundai ownership experience, with the brand using on-ground engagement to create opportunities for customers to connect with one another beyond their vehicle ownership. Hyundai's official customer-events platform describes the Carnival as a multi-city experience combining drives, games, food, music and entertainment. The initiative was first introduced in December 2023.

Nilesh Shah, National Head, Service, Hyundai Motor India Limited, said, “Meaningful customer experiences are an integral part of Hyundai's philosophy. Hyundai Explorers Carnival reflects our commitment to building customer relationships that extend beyond vehicle ownership.”

The 2026 Carnival will feature a mix of family entertainment, interactive games and activities, live performances and on-ground attractions. Participants will also have access to curated food and hospitality experiences, opportunities to connect with fellow Hyundai owners, and exclusive activities and rewards.

The programme is part of Hyundai's broader focus on customer engagement and community-building. The company's customer experience initiatives are designed to extend the relationship with customers beyond conventional vehicle ownership and create opportunities for continued engagement.

Customers in the five participating cities can register for the Carnival through Hyundai's designated Explorers Carnival platform. The 2026 edition will begin in Pune on October 3 and continue across the remaining four cities through December.
